alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a brick-red one on the right. In the very first frame both already have a speech bubble that says so. Both stop with wide eyes and glance at each other. The black one says you go, the red one says no, you. Then both start again with I and stop again. Finally both say never mind at exactly the same time and their eyes turn happy. At the end both narrow their eyes at the camera. The text stays: me and my friend starting to talk at the same time.
